name: firstlightui/app-shortcuts
description: Open a screen of your NativePHP app from Siri, Spotlight, the Shortcuts app and the app icon on iOS, and from launcher shortcuts on Android.

bridge_functions.name: AppShortcuts.Push
bridge_functions.description: Add or replace a shortcut in the app icon's long-press menu, newest first.

bridge_functions.name: AppShortcuts.Remove
bridge_functions.description: Remove a shortcut added with Push.

bridge_functions.name: AppShortcuts.Clear
bridge_functions.description: Remove every shortcut added with Push.
